title: Chapter 242 A Strong Man Goes Out To Rescue One Person
content:
Chapter 242 A Strong Man Goes Out To Rescue One Person

Wu Qing's Insect clones and Insect guards travel outside to contact other races. They are the face of the Insect race, and their strength must be improved.

As a five-star-strength insect clone, Wu Qing can exert a certain amount of combat power, and may be of some use on this public battlefield.

Wu Qing has discovered that the light attribute energy shield that cannot be broken by attacks at the five-star strength level was formed by the powerful human priests controlling a god-given object.

After this period of rest and recovery, some of the current Zerg queens have regained their ability to lay eggs.

Wu Qing wanted to try to see if the light attribute energy shield would be broken after killing the priest of the Tianwai human race.

The flying units of the Zerg race are faster than the Terran races that ride horses on the ground, and can follow them calmly and at a certain distance.

The Queen of the Zerg used her egg-laying ability on the priest of the Outer World. In an instant, the priest of the Outer World lost control of his body. The light attribute energy shield that had been protecting the mysterious human knight and the people around him was lost. out of control and gradually disappeared.

Without the protection of the light attribute energy shield, the mysterious human knight looked back at the human priests, stretched out his hand to call, and an object wrapped in white light and containing mysterious energy flew from the hands of a human priest and flew back to his in hand.

A small light energy shield that could only cover one person and one rider enveloped the mysterious human knight alone.

Several Zerg Queens sprayed out trapping nets to trap the knight team, which had lost its light attribute energy shield and numbered less than a thousand people.

A thousand five-star Zerg flying dragons took the lead in attacking!

"Rumble...!"

The terrifyingly powerful biological bomb exploded, and a large number of miniature biological bombs flew around, constantly hitting the target and detonating automatically.

Those who can be taken by the mysterious human knight are not weak in strength. They have lost their external defense. Their own light attribute energy flashes and various magical spells are used to eliminate the damage caused by explosive attacks.

"Bah bang bang...!"

The human priests among them were all attacked by the Zerg Queen's eggs. They could not hold on and continued to self-destruct, turning into light and passing away.

This seemed to be the prelude to death. As more biological bombs exploded around them, the most important figures in the Tianwai human army began to suffer casualties.

There were several powerful knights who raised their bows and shot arrows in an attempt to counterattack, but they did not seem to have the archery skills of the gryphon knights. The arrows they shot missed and could not hurt the five-star Zerg flying dragon flying at the front.

After they fired an arrow, a large number of five-star Zerg flying dragons concentrated fire attacks on them, blowing them up without a trace!

Only the mysterious human knight was not affected by the Zerg flying dragon's attack. He seemed to know that there was nothing he could do to save his life. He took out a strange whistle, and the energy in his hand vibrated, and the whistle made a unique sound.

A giant griffon, much larger than a five-star bright griffin, suddenly appeared on the eastern horizon and flew towards this direction at high speed.

Wu Qing, who was staying in the transport host loading space, had been observing the battlefield situation from the perspective of the Zerg host. As soon as the giant griffon appeared, a strong sense of crisis surged into his heart, urging him to leave here quickly.

The insect queen also sensed the danger. Dozens of powerful spiritual energy instantly descended on the four-star Zerg hosts surrounding the Zerg flying dragons. Their powers merged into one, and a terrifying aura appeared among the Zerg flying dragons.

"The strong man behind the Zerg takes action!"

"It must be the Tianwai Human Clan who has sent strong men! There should be important figures from them in this Tianwai Human Clan army!"

"I wonder if this time it will trigger a battle between strong men!"

"Don't worry! The strong men on both sides have a tacit understanding and will not take action casually!"

"I'm afraid that the strong people behind the Zerg don't know this tacit understanding!"

"Strong men have their own judgment and will not act arbitrarily!"

"..."

It’s no longer surprising that the Zerg race has strong people to protect them. It’s strange that such a powerful race doesn’t have strong people to protect them.

Now everyone is concerned about whether the strong men on both sides will fight. If the strong men take part, the war level of this public battlefield will increase, and the subsequent situation will become even more uncontrollable.

The powerful bright gryphon, summoned by the mysterious human knight, flew at high speed. When the power of the insect queen came, it slowed down its flying speed, but it was still flying in this direction.

It flew less eagerly, probably to express some goodwill and to show that it had no ill intentions and did not want to cause a battle between strong men.

The mysterious human knight who was in the middle of the biological bomb attack by the Zerg flying dragons had an object wrapped in light energy in his hand, and a mysterious energy suddenly burst out.

The war horse under the mysterious human knight was covered with mysterious energy. It seemed to have wings on its back, soaring into the sky and rushing toward the powerful light griffin that connected him at extremely fast speeds.

The Zerg Queen, who had been on standby, used spawning attacks on the mysterious human knight and the horse beneath him.

Several trapping nets passed over, and when they were rushed by the mysterious energy, the trapping nets that fell on the mysterious human knight and his horse lost their due effect and failed to affect their speed.

"That should be a kind of divine power. The spawning attack can't kill him, so forget it!"

Wu Qing did not let the insect queen use other means and continued to hunt down the mysterious human knight.

He has the power of gods and can summon powerful light griffins to pick him up. This is not a simple alien human knight. If the Zerg Queen's spawning can't kill him, Wu Qing is not going to cause this trouble for the time being.

This chapter is not over yet, please click on the next page to continue reading!

Wu Qing has been paying attention to the situation of the mysterious human knight. Seeing that he ran all the way to the back of the giant light griffin that greeted him, and did not self-destruct, he knew that the Zerg Queen's spawning attack was ineffective for the first time under the influence of the magical power of gods.

The powerful light griffin, after picking up the mysterious human knight, turned and flew away, without participating in the battlefield, as if only to save that person.

Things can't be done, Wu Qing can see it openly. Just arrived at this battlefield, if you can't touch the enemy's bottom line, don't touch it for the time being, so as not to let the enemy go crazy and keep targeting the Zerg.

The biggest fish ran away, and the remaining big fish can't be let go. The Zerg flying dragon group took turns to fight, bombarded wildly, and finally eliminated all the important people brought out by the mysterious human knight.

Two transport Zerg hosts flew down, released Zerg worker bees, and collected the precious items that had not been destroyed on the battlefield.

These people are the most important figures in the alien army. They must have brought a lot of good things with them, but most of them were damaged in the bombardment of the Zerg flying dragons.

Wu Qing doesn't care about the value of these things. What he cares about is some information about the aliens contained in these things.

The battles in other areas of the battlefield are basically over. With such a huge gap in the strength of the enemy and us, the local camp army can pile up the enemy to death even if they use people.

This wonderful battle ended with the complete victory of the local camp!

After the war, the armies of various races in the local camp remained in place and did not move at will. The real protagonist of this war was the Zerg army. The Zerg army had to take the majority of the large amount of spoils left on the entire battlefield. The specific distribution should be based on the opinions of the Zerg.

Here, there are big tribes three feet above your head, and no one dares to mess around.

Wu Qing had learned about this situation from the intelligence given by Gong Rui. He took a transport host and flew to a high position in the middle of the battlefield. He sent out a Zerg host to invite representatives of the various races that participated in the war to come to discuss matters.

No one dared to neglect the invitation of the Zerg, and basically the leaders of various races came in person.

The races participating in the war here are varied, many of which Wu Qing could not name, and most of them were races he had never seen before.

The performance of the Zerg army in the previous war was recognized by everyone, and everyone was very respectful and friendly to the Zerg.

Wu Qing was not arrogant, and was very easy-going. At first glance, he was a person who was easy to get along with.

After a round of compliments and politeness, he got to the point.

"The spoils on the battlefield will be distributed according to the rules, and my Zerg will never take advantage of it!"

"In addition, all the spoils obtained by my Zerg can be exchanged with the luck beads!"

"As long as you make an offer, we will immediately make a deal if we think it is appropriate!"

"..."

Wu Qing said a few simple words.

The specific distribution of the spoils of war will be discussed with the Queen of Insects. Wu Qing cares about exchanging the spoils of war in his hands for the resources needed by the Zerg.

Many things in the alien army were destroyed by the Zerg army, but there are still a lot of useful spoils of war. These things are of no value to the Zerg, but for other races, some things are rare treasures.

Wu Qing needs the luck beads. As long as others offer a price, anything can be sold. The Queen of Insects will know the specific value.

The races that can enter the public battlefield of the southern war zone are all races with certain strength in the outside world, otherwise they don’t even have the qualifications to enter this battlefield.

They all have a certain family background, and they must have a large stock of hard currency such as luck beads.

It is very difficult for the army of the alien army and the army of the local camp to defeat them, let alone annihilate them. It is difficult for the local camp to obtain the spoils of the alien army, so these spoils are more precious.

Some of the equipment and supplies in the alien human army are extremely valuable even if they are damaged, not to mention that there are still a lot of logistical combat supplies that are intact.

Wu Qing proposed to exchange the spoils of war shared by the Zerg for the Qiyun Beads, which made all the races very happy. They sent people to prepare Qiyun Beads one after another, wanting to grab the most valuable part of the spoils.

Wu Qing showed up and handed over the specific matters to the Queen of Zerg, who controlled the Zerg host to negotiate and execute the specific matters.
